questions.question_text: Who is considered the founder of the University of the Punjab?
questions.explanation: Dr. G.W. Leitner was the primary figure behind the establishment of the University of the Punjab in 1882.

questions.question_text: Which is the largest province of Pakistan by land area?
questions.explanation: Balochistan covers approximately 44% of the total land area of Pakistan.

questions.question_text: Which is the national flower of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Jasmine (Chambeli) is the national flower of Pakistan.

questions.question_text: Who was the first Prime Minister of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Liaquat Ali Khan served as the first Prime Minister of Pakistan.

questions.question_text: What is the capital of Turkey?
questions.explanation: Ankara is the capital city of Turkey.

questions.explanation: Mars is referred to as the Red Planet due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question_text: What is the currency of Japan?
questions.explanation: The Japanese Yen is the official currency of Japan.

questions.explanation: The Nile is generally considered the longest river in the world.

questions.explanation: WWW stands for the World Wide Web.

questions.explanation: Japan is known as the Land of the Rising Sun.

questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth.

questions.explanation: The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) is the regulatory agency for telecommunications in Pakistan.

questions.explanation: K2, the second-highest mountain in the world, is situated in the Karakoram range.
